headline: Island Bases Churn Rapidly While Heavy Carnage Batters Northern Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Fisherman’s Row has reignited with ferocious volatility, recording sixteen strategic base transfers over the last two hours across Eidolo, Dankana Post, and Arcadia. Callahan’s Passage remains locked in grinding upheaval, posting eight base shifts and more than thirty-five hundred combined casualties in the same span as fighting engulfs The Crumbling Passage and The Latch. In the east, Weathered Expanse continues to suffer staggering losses, yielding four base turnovers and over four thousand fresh casualties around Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Stlican Shelf maintains its bitterly contested split, adding three base exchanges and roughly twenty-six hundred dead between Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. By contrast, territorial transfers have halted across Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line over the past two hours, yet heavy carnage endures unabated, with Linn of Mercy logging over twenty-three hundred casualties—weighted heavily toward Warden losses—and Nevish Line generating more than twenty-five hundred dead. Other sectors, including Mooring County and Marban Hollow, remain comparatively dormant without fresh base movements.
